div.div: One listener serves four surfaces behind the same router and controls; each accepts only its own credentials, so no token of one authenticates on another. Three are APIs, each from its own OpenAPI document with a generated server and client: /api/v1, public and supported; /operator/v1, the operator's alone; /worker/v1, the launcher's internal protocol. /state/v1 speaks Terraform's http backend protocol through a hand-written handler, and departs from the shared controls only where decision 0003 records it.

div.div: The typed handler that oapi-codegen writes from a contract (strict-server: true in api/oapi-server-<svc>.yaml). Each operation becomes a Go method that takes a typed request (path, query, headers and the decoded JSON body) and returns one of the typed responses the contract declares, so a handler cannot answer a shape the contract lacks. The generated wrapper decodes and writes the HTTP, and an error becomes a problem+json answer; the domain code implements only the methods. It types requests but does not validate bounds or unknown fields: the shared router checks those before the handler, on every surface.

text.tspan: The typed handler that oapi-codegen writes from a contract (strict-server: true in api/oapi-server-<svc>.yaml). Each operation becomes a Go method that takes a typed request (path, query,

fields: the shared router checks those before the handler, on every surface.
